task.title: Relics: no body conflict after a skipped identical save
task.description:
A relic is a record in Workbook beside tasks. It holds specs, plans, decisions and similar material as named parts, with the same history and sharing that tasks have.

This is a follow-up from the review of the first six relics stories (finding M14). It was left out of that work on purpose.

## Problem

During a replay, a local body save is skipped when origin already holds the same text. A later local save in the same replay still names the local version as its base, so it is reported as a body conflict although nothing diverged. No text is lost, because the local tip is parked.

## Wanted

Treat the skipped save's version and origin's version of the same text as the same base for the saves that follow it.

## Done when

- Two clones save the same text to one part, one of them saves again on top, and its sync replays the second save with no conflict.
- A save whose base really is stale still stops as a conflict.
